doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His wife Helen and the date of their marriage
summary: He gives his wife's name as Helen Henry and says they married on August 16, probably 1941; the first tape ends.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So you got married to your wife before you went into the Army?

So you had to have automatic separation there because I know they weren’t letting privates go as any kind of accompanied tour. So you got married, then you got sent to McLellan. Can we get your wife’s name on tape? Go ahead and get that stated. Her maiden name was what?
Her name was Elizabeth Helen Hamilton, Helen Henry.
I’m going to ask you for the tape, what was the date of your marriage. We can come back and splice it in later if you don’t remember so you don’t get in trouble.
I got married on 16 of August because her birthday was on the 20th of August.
So it would be ‘41 I guess.
Is that it for the tape? Okay, so we’re going to have to break every hour so he can change the tape.
